instruction: Candid medium close-up of two men sparring in an outdoor covered training area. On the left, the man in the blue tank top (R2) is seen in profile, holding a high guard with black boxing gloves. On the right, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) ducks low beneath R2's guard. Bright daylight illuminates the scene under the white roof structure.
